Designing the multi-channel network and planning the implementation of new solutions (e.g., shops, lockers, digital points), ensuring alignment with the Country Project. 2. Manage local relationships with administrative/political bodies, and proactively advise on and execute physical partnerships and new business initiatives. 3. Execute land commercialization actions (sales or commercialization of vacant premises), following Asset Manager guidelines. jobs.title: Category Analyst
jobs.description: The Category Analyst is crucial in supporting the planning and execution of sales targets, analyzing sales data, coordinating demand planning for new collections, managing inventory effectively, and conducting competitor checks. They work closely with departments such as Sales, Creative, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Production, Quality Control, and Distribution to ensure alignment and optimize performance. What you'll do: Target Setting: Assist in setting monthly sales targets based on historical sales trends per month per class category and store performance. Sales Data Analysis: Monitor sell-through of all collections launched within the past six months. Generate monthly sales reports for assigned categories. Demand Planning and Execution for New Collections: Collaborate in proposing collection budgets based on historical sales trends. Assist in planning upcoming collection demand by analyzing class type, sub-class types, sizes, fabric, color, and design/styles. Coordinate with Production and Quality Control departments to ensure the availability of new collections before the launch date. Coordinate with the Distribution Department to align delivery schedules based on allocation. Generate reports comparing transfer orders versus out slips for new collections. Identify and consolidate low and broken on-hand quantities per style in all stores to the store with the highest sales demand. jobs.title: Import Department Buyer

The Supply Chain Associate handles communication with global suppliers and assists in the product development cycle. This role is essential in managing the end-to-end supply chain processes, particularly focused on international purchasing, vendor management, and ensuring timely and cost-effective importation of goods. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of global supply chains, procurement practices, and import regulations. Key responsibilities include : Vendor Management: Identify and establish relationships with international suppliers and negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts. Purchasing & Procurement: Manage the procurement of goods from international markets, ensuring the best quality, price, and delivery terms. Order Management: Place and track purchase orders, manage order confirmations, and resolve discrepancies with suppliers. Logistics Coordination: Coordinate shipments with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of imported goods. Import Documentation: Ensure all required documents (commercial invoices, bills of lading, certificates of origin, etc.) are accurate and compliant with international and local regulations. Inventory Management: Monitor stock levels and work with internal teams to ensure optimal inventory levels are maintained. Customs Compliance: Ensure adherence to all customs laws, regulations, and import/export guidelines, including tariff classifications and duty calculations. Cost Control: Analyze and manage procurement costs to align with budgetary goals and maximize savings. Vendor Performance Evaluation: Track supplier performance, delivery times, and quality, and work with vendors to improve service. Payment Processing: Track incoming payments, accurately apply them to customer accounts, and resolve any discrepancies. Account Reconciliation: Regularly reconcile customer accounts to ensure balances are accurate and up to date. Aging Report Management: Maintain and monitor accounts receivable aging reports, following up on overdue accounts and escalating problematic cases as needed. Customer Communication: Build and maintain relationships with customers to resolve billing and payment issues, and negotiate payment plans when necessary. Credit Limits & Terms: Recommend credit limits and payment terms based on company guidelines and credit risk assessment. Dispute Resolution: Work with internal departments (sales, customer service, etc.) to resolve billing disputes and ensure smooth resolution. Reporting: Prepare regular reports on collection efforts, credit issues, and overall account status for management review.
